$comment: Watermark for the sync-memory skill. Records the last commit reconciled into this repo's memory (CONTEXT.md + docs/adr/) per sibling repo. The skill advances this after an approved run; edit by hand only to reset a repo's start point. Seeded to the sibling repos' local HEADs at the time the memory baseline (ADR-0001..0003, the seam docs) was established, so the first run sweeps only changes that land after this baseline.
